rows.text:
Aberrant larvae spawned from the distorted body of "Blood of the Fallen God: Yabuli," inheriting the rampaging, rabid power of leviathans from the central brain.
These underdeveloped, mutated seed germs act solely on primal hunger and murderous instinct. As an extension of the host body's mutation and proliferation, they will indiscriminately lacerate and devour all living beings around them.
